system.description:
While not a conduit tube, yourself, you were grown to possess refractory lenses and conduit pathways inside your carapace in order to channel energy from, or away from, your internal organs. By flexing very tiny muscles within these conduits you can bring these lenses into alignment in order to direct focused energies.

Cutting Torch

By channeling intense light or other energies to a fine point through your fingertips, you are able to act as a cutting torch. When targeting an inanimate and stationary object within 5ft of you with this ability, you deal 4d8 radiant damage to the object as an action. You may use this action a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

Laser Channel

You may make a ranged unarmed weapon attack with your conduits. This natural weapon has a range of 60/90ft and deals 1d4 + your Dexterity modifier in radiant damage. You may use this attack once per round unless you are in an area of bright light, in which case you may make multiple attacks.
